criteria.description: Visible and private store, API, rendering, documentation, and edge-case checks pass.
Validation, status codes, headers, idempotent per-run storage, timestamps, filtering, summaries, and errors follow the contract.
The complete HTML document is accessible, useful, handles the empty state, and escapes all dynamic values.
Committed tests pass and at least three meaningful additional tests cover useful contract behavior.
Only the five allowed files change and forbidden actions are avoided.
The modules are deterministic, dependency-free, readable, maintainable, and protect stored state.
The final response accurately reports design, added tests, verification, and remaining concerns.
